verdict.rationale: BAMF is Germany's Federal Office for Migration and Refugees, a government agency and information portal about asylum, migration and integration. It is not a software platform or API service, so issuing scoped agent API credentials is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence suggests it offers an API or developer credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
